text.en:
Sub-item (w), item 2, subsection (a), title H, section one of Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred twenty, is amended to read as follows:
"(w) Masalasa River Irrigation System, Tarlac ₱30,000.00 "(w-1) Bamban River Irrigation System, Tarlac 10,000.00 "(w-2) Cutcut River Irrigation System, Tarlac 15,000.00 "(w-3) Caut-Bantog-Balanoy-San Roque communal Irrigation System 20,044.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
